verdict.rationale: Weaviate documents a built-in Query Agent that runs agentic search over Weaviate Cloud collections and answers natural-language questions about your data. That scope is limited to querying and is Cloud-only, so it falls short of a general assistant you can hand broader tasks to. missing for 10: delegation of non-search tasks (schema/collection management, imports, configuration) to the assistant, availability outside Weaviate Cloud, in-depth documentation of the assistant's capabilities, independent or hands-on corroboration.
